title: Regular bail for a tractor driver after a fatal NH-8 accident — Sessions, Udaipur

input.text: Namaste. Main naya enrolled advocate hoon, District & Sessions Court Udaipur. Client Ramesh Chandra Meena, 34, Mavli ke paas gaon, tractor chala raha tha 12.11.2026 ko NH-8 par shaam 7:45. Motorcycle se takkar, ek vyakti hospital mein expire. FIR 142/2026 PS Mavli, 279/304A IPC (BNS corresponding) + MV Act. Judicial custody 14.11.2026 se. Koi purana criminal record nahi, do bacche, kisan. Kal subah Sessions Judge ke saamne regular bail chahiye — §483 BNSS / §439 CrPC, custody calculation, COURT_SAFE citations only, English + simple Hindi grounds. Family bahar baithe hain.

triage.oneLineRead: First regular bail on a 304A/BNS 106-type allegation; file has almost no papers and default-bail arithmetic cannot be completed.

issueMap.note: Beginners file under the wrong section. Map BNSS 480/483 against CrPC 437/439 before drafting the cause title.

issueMap.issue: Whether the facts even attract the fleeing-aggravated limb
issueMap.note: Family says he stopped and informed police. That fact, if true, kills a harsher limb — but it is oral.

issueMap.issue: Default bail / outer limit under BNSS 187 / CrPC 167
issueMap.note: No remand order date, no charge-sheet status.

teachingNotes: A beginner’s first 304A bail is lost on the cause title and on a remembered citation, not on sympathy.
Default bail is a calculation, not a vibe. Without remand dates the engine must say CANNOT_COMPUTE.
Bilingual grounds are for the family and the court; they are not a licence to file unverified holdings.
commonMistakes: Citing a famous SC bail case without a paragraph and a COURT_SAFE tag.
Filing before the CJM when the Sessions Court is the right forum, or the reverse.
Writing 'no antecedents' as a proved fact from the family's mouth.
seniorVariants: Cause title: Sessions Judge, Udaipur; FIR 142/2026 PS Mavli; BNSS 483 with CrPC 439 in parentheses.
Put the 'stopped at the spot' fact as an oral instruction, not as evidence.
Ask for local sureties and a no-contact / driving-licence condition in the alternative.

accuracy.adverseFact: If the FIR actually records fleeing the spot, the family's 'he stopped' story is an adverse fact that will be read against the accused at the first listing.
accuracy.jurisdictionNote: Sessions Court, Udaipur. High Court (Jodhpur principal seat) is the next bail rung, not the first.
